messages:
Ana: Heads up — nightly billing export created ~120 $0-credit invoices for multiple customers. Looks like 'usage_cutoff' got shifted. @Mike @Olivia can you take a look? billing-bot posted the run logs.

Mike: Looking now. Do we have the job run id?

billing-bot: nightly-billing-export (run_id=2026-03-22T02:00Z-789)
status: completed
rows_exported: 10234
credits_applied: 120
cutoff_timestamp: 2026-03-21T00:00:00

Olivia: I think this started after the infra change where we consolidated cron runners and switched the host TZ to America/Los_Angeles. Exports were assuming UTC cutoff.

Sam: Confirming. Export code uses naive date arithmetic: cutoff = today.replace(hour=0, minute=0) which inherits local TZ. Some customer usage timestamps are stored in UTC -> mismatch.

Mike: Oof. Can you paste the export cron? I want to patch quickly.

Sam: cron entry:
```
0 2 * * * /srv/redwood/bin/export_billing --env=prod --cutoff '00:00'
```
I suggest we make it explicit: `--cutoff '00:00:00 UTC'` and change code to use timezone-aware cutoffs.

Ana: What is the estimated financial impact? Are these invoices already sent to customers?

Olivia: Only drafts were generated; doesn't look like emails went out, but AR and revenue recognition saw zeros in the nightly report. Rough numbers: ~120 credits, estimated $3.2k MRR effect for March if not fixed.

Mike: I'll hotfix in billing-export repo, add unit tests, and re-run the export as a one-off. Will open PR and trigger a dry-run first.

Mike: PR -> https://git.internal/redwood/billing-export/pull/412
summary: make cutoff tz-aware; add integration test for DST and TZ boundary

billing-bot: scheduled job re-run (manual) started (run_id=2026-03-22T03:15Z-790)

billing-bot: re-run complete. rows_exported: 10254, credits_applied: 0, cutoff_timestamp: 2026-03-22T00:00:00Z

Ana: Nice. Please add an entry to the billing incident log and notify Accounting so they can revert the draft zero-credit invoices and re-generate final invoices after we confirm.

Mike: Will do. Adding to postmortems/billing and pinging @Accounting.

Olivia: Also recommend a one-off reconciliation job to compare nightly export vs. source of truth for the last 7 days. I'll file a ticket.

Sam: Filed -> https://triage.internal/tickets/6821

Ana: Thanks everyone. Keep me posted once Accounting confirms.
